fields.notes: OCP is an on-chip interface specification; it imposes interface timing/handshake constraints (the per-phase accept handshakes, synchronous sampling on Clk), not PDK-specific SDC/floorplan rules. Physical constraints (timing closure at the OCP clock, the bus wrapper's implementation) are chip/SoC concerns.

interface_constraints.clocking: synchronous to the OCP clock Clk; EnableClk qualifies active edges

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
